scope: Fixed supplemental controls only; not the eight-ratio onset coverage or an accuracy certification.
repeat_sampling_note: The original short run clips its final timestep to diffusive time 0.2 and writes that endpoint; the long run normally steps past 0.2 without clipping there. The 0.15--0.2 fits therefore need not use the same sample times or sample count. Even samples of an identical underlying trajectory can yield different fitted rates when growth varies within the window. A repeated-window difference can thus reflect endpoint sampling as well as changes in the numerical trajectory; it alone does not establish a physical growth-rate change. The fits use each run's original samples without resampling. Sample counts, sampled intervals, and source provenance are retained in JSON.
limitations: All reported estimates require three completed float64 runs at matched physical and numerical parameters.
Neutral estimates require a measured decay/growth bracket; missing brackets are not extrapolated.
Window variation and repeated-window differences are diagnostics, not statistical uncertainty.
The four sampled modes/orientations do not establish the global discrete minimum.
Unrelated pending or invalid CSV files are audited but do not determine supplemental control coverage.
